subject: Request: Teaching Residency — short pilot + cloud grant for spring fellows
messages:
From: Dr. Emily Ross <emily.ross@northbrook.edu>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Teaching residency — cloud access + promotional support?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the students (and faculty) were excited by the low-latency codegen and the classroom monitoring examples. We're running a short teaching residency in May for 10 graduate fellows and would love to include Redwood as the compute backend. Two asks: 1) a three-month trial extension (we've already used the initial pilot credits during final exams) and 2) an education grant/credits to cover the expected spike in token usage (~$6k–$10k estimate).

Attached is a one-page syllabus and a quick scope spreadsheet (teaching_residency_syllabus.pdf, pilot_scope.xlsx). Procurement will need a formal offer and any SOC2/attestation details before they sign off. Our procurement contact is procurement@northbrook.edu — copied here for transparency.

Can Redwood support an expedited education credit approval and an extension to May 31 for trial access? We can schedule a quick sync with procurement if that's helpful.

Best,
Emily
Dr. Emily Ross
Director, Computational Education
Northbrook Community College

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Emily Ross <emily.ross@northbrook.edu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Teaching residency — cloud access + promotional support?

Hi Emily — great to hear the demo landed well. Thanks for the syllabus and scope, that helps a lot.

Quick notes:
- I'll pull together a recommended credit amount based on the pilot_scope.xlsx you sent; initial read suggests the $6k–$10k band is reasonable for 10 fellows over 3 months.
- Marissa (cc'd) handles credit approvals and promotional bundles; she'll confirm the education grant cadence and any paperwork.
- Vivek (cc'd) can quickly run the SOC2/KYC checklist and clarify what we can attach for procurement.

If procurement needs written terms, we can provide a short exhibit that states: trial extension to 2027-05-31 + $8,000 promotional credit applied as usage offset. That exhibit is typically attached to a one-page PO acknowledgement. Would that work for you? If so, please confirm the billing contact and any required PO language.

I'll follow up internally and aim to get a draft out tomorrow.

Cheers,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Emily Ross <emily.ross@northbrook.edu>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Teaching residency — cloud access + promotional support?

Hi all — copied PV and procurement notes below for clarity.

We can offer a one-time education promotional credit of $8,000 and a trial extension until 2027-05-31 under the following quick conditions:
- Northbrook confirms the billing contact and submits a PO referencing HubSpot deal HS-45231.
- Use is limited to the teaching residency/academically-affiliated projects (we can include a short sentence in the exhibit).
- Credit applied as usage offset; any overage billed at standard rates.

Next steps for Emily/procurement: send PO to finance@redwoodinference.com with the PO number and billing contact details — we'll attach the exhibit and SOC2 attestation. Vivek: can you attach the current SOC2 attestation and the security questionnaire link?

I'll draft the exhibit now and share a PDF for signature. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if procurement would prefer.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Dr. Emily Ross <emily.ross@northbrook.edu>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Northbrook College Procurement <procurement@northbrook.edu>
Date: 2027-04-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Teaching residency — cloud access + promotional support?

Thanks Marissa — that's exactly what procurement asked for. Procurement (copied) — we will prepare a PO this week. A couple of small clarifications from procurement:

1) Are we able to restrict the credit to the account/organization level (so it cannot be transferred outside the faculty accounts)?
2) We need the SOC2 attestation and the level of data retention retention for logs (how long are request/usage logs kept?)

Procurement: billing contact will be Linda Zhou, Controller — linda.zhou@northbrook.edu. PO will reference HS-45231.

Date: 2027-04-07T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Teaching residency — cloud access + promotional support?

Hi Emily and team — looping in a couple practical notes from the security side.

1) SOC2 attestation attached (SOC2-attestation.pdf). We can also provide a completed security questionnaire if procurement needs it — here's a short link to the questionnaire form: https://redwoodinference.com/sec-qa.
2) Credit scoping: we can restrict the promotional credit to the Northbrook org-id and limit usage to the project tags (we'll implement this on the backend). That prevents accidental transfer to other accounts.
3) Data retention for request logs: default retention is 90 days for usage logs and 365 days for billing metadata; if you require a different retention policy for the residency we can discuss a short-term exception.

Marissa: I've attached the SOC2 and created a Drive folder with the exhibit draft (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cTeachingResidencyPilot). Emily/Linda: once you send the PO to finance@redwoodinference.com, I'll confirm the account scoping and apply the $8,000 credit and the May 31 trial extension.

If procurement wants to review the exhibit quickly, I can join a 20-minute call tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Customer Success — Education & Research
Redwood Inference
